name: MPT Malwa Resort Restaurant
area: Inside MPT Malwa Resort, edge of Sagar Talao
signature_dish: Malwa-style dal bati paniya overlooking Sagar Talao
why_it_matters: Madhya Pradesh Tourism's flagship Mandu property, set on the bank of Sagar Talao (the largest of Mandu's medieval lakes). The in-house restaurant serves Malwa-region food (dal-bati-paniya is the regional signature, distinct from Rajasthani dal-bati-churma) plus the standard MPT multi-cuisine menu. Breakfast on the terrace overlooking the water is the standout meal — one of central India's most under-rated lake-views.
insider_tip: Reserve breakfast 7-9am on the terrace overlooking Sagar Talao — it's the best window before tourist coaches arrive. Best at sunset (5-6pm Oct-Mar) too. Open to non-resident diners but Nov-Feb weekends require a reservation. The Roopmati Pavilion (Rani Roopmati monument) is 5km away — pair lunch here with the late-afternoon Roopmati visit.
signature_address: MPT Malwa Resort, Mandav, Dhar District, Madhya Pradesh 454010

name: Shivani Restaurant
area: Main Market, near Hotel Mandu Sarai
signature_dish: Dal bati paniya with kadhi (Malwa village template)
why_it_matters: Mandu Main Market's go-to local-format restaurant — Tripadvisor reviewers consistently flag Shivani as the right place to eat dal-bati-paniya (the Malwa village staple: dal-baati but baked with onion-stuffed paniya patties instead of churma). Run for the village, not for the tour-bus crowd; ambience is rustic, the kitchen does what it's known for and not much more.
insider_tip: Order dal-bati-paniya (not the Rajasthani churma version) — that's why this place exists. Cash only. Don't expect ambience — the food is the trade. Mandu town infrastructure is genuinely limited (ruined hilltop with a small village layered on); Shivani's role is filling the gap MPT Malwa Resort leaves at the budget tier.
signature_address: Main Market, Near Hotel Mandu Sarai, Mandav, Dhar District, Madhya Pradesh 454010

name: MPT Travellers Lodge Restaurant
area: Inside MPT Travellers Lodge, near Jahaz Mahal
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine lunch near the Jahaz Mahal monuments
why_it_matters: MPT's second Mandu property (the budget-tier alongside the higher-end Malwa Resort) — located walking distance from Jahaz Mahal and the Royal Enclave. Useful as a lunch stop on a long-monument day when you don't want to drive back to Sagar Talao. Quality is consistent MPT-standard, not destination-grade.
insider_tip: Pair with the Jahaz Mahal-Hindola Mahal-Champa Baoli morning circuit — lunch here, then walk over to the Royal Enclave for the afternoon. Mid-Mar to mid-June is too hot for the walking; restrict to the Oct-Feb window. Reservation not needed off-season; Nov-Feb weekends recommended.
signature_address: MPT Travellers Lodge, Near Jahaz Mahal, Mandav, Dhar District, Madhya Pradesh 454010
